system.name: ISAMORE
system.one_liner: an end-to-end framework that discovers reusable custom RISC-V instructions from domain applications via e-graph anti-unification

components.name: Domain programs
components.role: set of domain-representative programs used as ISAMORE's input

components.name: LLVM
components.role: compiles domain programs to LLVM IR

components.name: DSL
components.role: ISAMORE's structured domain-specific language encoding the compiled IR

components.name: E-graph
components.role: e-graph encoding of the DSL program, the design entry for the RII flow

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: drives the phase-oriented iterative RII process, selecting which ruleset each phase applies

components.name: Ruleset generation
components.role: offline process constructing the rulesets each RII phase applies

components.name: Ruleset
components.role: the set of rewrite rules an RII phase applies, produced by ruleset generation

components.name: Phase
components.role: one iteration of RII applying EqSat, smart AU, vectorize, select, and extract steps

components.name: EqSat
components.role: equality-saturation step expanding the e-graph with equivalent forms

components.name: smart AU
components.role: scalable e-graph anti-unification technique identifying reusable patterns

components.name: vectorize
components.role: pattern vectorization packing scalar operations into vectorized custom instructions

components.name: select
components.role: Pareto-optimal pattern selection balancing performance gains and area overhead

components.name: extract
components.role: extracts the selected patterns/program from the e-graph

components.name: profile
components.role: realistic performance information from instrumenting and profiling the LLVM IR

components.name: Cost model
components.role: hardware-aware cost model guiding pattern selection and extraction, informed by profiling, PDK, and HLS

components.name: PDK
components.role: target process design kit informing the cost model's hardware estimates

components.name: Patterns
components.role: reusable pattern solutions produced by RII

components.name: HLS
components.role: high-level synthesis engine estimating hardware performance/overhead and generating hardware implementations

components.name: CI0, CI1, ...
components.role: final sets of custom instructions with hardware implementations, ISAMORE's output

content.key_idea: ISAMORE compiles domain programs into an e-graph and iteratively applies equality saturation, anti-unification, and vectorization inside a cost-model-guided Phase loop to extract Pareto-optimal, reusable custom instructions, synthesized to hardware via HLS.
content.reading_order: Left to right: Domain programs through LLVM/DSL into the E-graph, into the iterative RII Scheduler/Phase loop, out to Patterns and HLS-generated custom instructions.

summary: This figure gives ISAMORE's end-to-end framework overview for discovering reusable RISC-V custom instructions. Domain-representative programs are compiled to LLVM IR, translated into ISAMORE's structured DSL, and encoded as an E-graph, the design entry for RII (Reusable Instruction Identification), the paper's core contribution. RII's Scheduler iterates over Phases, each applying a Ruleset (built offline by Ruleset generation) through equality saturation (EqSat), the novel smart-AU anti-unification technique, pattern vectorization, and Pareto-optimal pattern selection/extraction. A hardware-aware Cost model, informed by profiling the LLVM IR and the target PDK, guides these phase decisions using performance/overhead estimates from a high-level-synthesis (HLS) engine. The resulting reusable Patterns are finally translated by the HLS engine into concrete custom instructions (CI0, CI1, ...) with hardware implementations. The figure is drawn as a left-to-right pipeline with one boxed iterative loop (Scheduler/Phase) in the middle.
summary_zh: 该图展示 ISAMORE 框架：程序经 LLVM、DSL 编译为 E-graph，RII 由 Scheduler 驱动 Phase 循环执行等价饱和、smart AU 反统一与向量化，经成本模型指导，由 HLS 生成可复用自定义指令。
